answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent must forge a 50-credit bond with an onyx seal. It decays 10% per epoch unless one task is done; each task sends a ripple neighbors attest; at zero it loses its share. 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and need 1,000 tasks per epoch at 12 each, 12,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented onyx seal fails: a reused serial is flagged and burned. An honest agent pays 50 once, does one task per epoch, and keeps a full share.
